adaptation: Al-Fatihah is aligned to the app's existing Hafs verse keys: the unnumbered basmala becomes 1:1, verses 1-5 become 1:2-1:6, and verses 6-7 are joined as 1:7. No Quran words are rewritten. Other verse boundaries remain unchanged.
wordPositions: Only verified consonantal matches are mapped. Zero means an unverified position; word highlighting is omitted and incomplete line translations are not displayed.
reviewStatus: Requires human Quran text and visual review before release
